lines.rom: jaya jaya sri bagalamukhi mata arati karahum tumhari
pita vasana tana para tava sohai kundala ki chabi nyari
kara kamalom mem mudgara dharai astuti karahim sakala nara nari
campaka mala gale laharave sura nara muni jaya jayati ucari
trividha tapa miti jata sakala saba bhakti sada tava hai sukhakari
